subtitle: Out Manila · Cathay Pacific
overview: Fly via Hong Kong to Changsha, then travel on to the hanging waterfall town of Furong and the Avatar scenic area of Zhangjiajie. The tour includes the Grand Canyon Glass Bridge, Golden Whip Stream and a night view of Furong Town, with local 5-star hotels, an English-speaking guide and a private coach. The connecting flights in Hong Kong are taken on your own.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 25–30 2027 to Mar 8–13 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Changsha: The capital of Hunan province, where the tour starts and ends and enjoys local food.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon Glass Bridge: A glass-floored bridge across a canyon near Zhangjiajie, walked on the C Line with a VR experience.
placeDesc.Furong Town: An ancient Tujia town built beside a waterfall, enjoyed here by day and with a night view.
placeDesc.Avatar scenic area: Sandstone pillar peaks in Zhangjiajie that inspired the floating mountains in the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A tall outdoor glass elevator built against a cliff, used to go up and down in the Avatar scenic area.
placeDesc.No. 1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge in the Zhangjiajie park, a scenic viewing stop in the Avatar area.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The pillar mountain in Zhangjiajie that inspired the floating Hallelujah Mountains in the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Golden Whip Stream: A scenic stream valley in Zhangjiajie, walked between rock walls and forest.
placeDesc.Junsheng Sandstone Painting Museum: A museum in Zhangjiajie showing paintings made with local sandstone.
placeDesc.72-floor Stilts Tower: A tall tower in Zhangjiajie built in the style of a stilted house, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Huangxing Road Walking Street: Changsha's central pedestrian shopping street, busy with shops, snacks and street life.
placeDesc.Baofeng Lake: A mountain lake near Zhangjiajie, visited on an optional cruise.
placeDesc.Tianmen Mountain: A mountain near Zhangjiajie reached by cable car, with a glass skywalk and the Tianmen Cave (optional tour).
